title: Yuri Lowenthal
summary:
Yuri Lowenthal is a voice actor who has voiced several anime and video game characters including Lok Lambert in Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

Yuri Lowenthal was born in Ohio as the son of a Foreign Service officer, resulting in his being raised in the United States, Africa, and Europe. He was graduated from the College of William and Mary with a degree in East Asian studies and held a job with the Japanese government prior to starting his acting career. In addition to numerous voice acting positions, Lowenthal has performed in theater and on camera.
